venues.name: Taberna da Rua
venues.description: Neighborhood bistro in Baixa known for a fixed-price prix fixe menu with a daily vegetarian main.

venues.name: Verde Alfama
venues.description: Plant-forward Alfama kitchen with fully vegan and gluten-free tasting options and river views.

venues.name: Halal House Mouraria
venues.description: Family-run Mouraria spot serving certified halal grills and vegetarian mezze platters.

venues.name: Cais Gourmet Prime
venues.description: High-end waterfront tasting-menu restaurant — included to exercise the budget-ceiling breach case.

venues.name: Miradouro Sunset Bar
venues.description: Rooftop small-plates bar with a very narrow 18:00-20:00 service window — exercises the operating-hours constraint.

venues.name: Time Out Market Food Hall
venues.description: Large food hall with stalls covering every major dietary tag; long hours make it a reliable fallback.

venues.name: Belem Pastel Cafe
venues.description: Historic pastelaria near the Belem tower famous for custard tarts and coffee.

venues.name: Castelo de Sao Jorge Tour
venues.description: Guided tour of the hilltop Moorish castle with panoramic city and river views.

venues.name: Tram 28 Heritage Ride
venues.description: Classic yellow tram route winding through Graca, Alfama, Baixa and Estrela.

venues.name: Oceanario de Lisboa
venues.description: One of Europe's largest aquariums in Parque das Nacoes; roughly 90-minute visit.

venues.name: LX Factory Creative Walk
venues.description: Free self-guided stroll through a converted industrial complex of shops, murals and studios.

venues.name: Alfama Boutique Lodge
venues.description: Small boutique guesthouse in the heart of Alfama, walking distance to the castle and river.

venues.name: Baixa Central Apartments
venues.description: Self-catering apartments in downtown Baixa, steps from Rossio and the metro.

venues.name: Principe Real Garden Rooms
venues.description: Upscale design hotel by the botanical garden — a premium lodging option above typical group budgets.
